name: 0a7eacd47c3a
claim: fleet_topology.cross_reachable=false blocks all LAN peer flushes across subnets; a queued file is not delivery until the peer runs start.ps1 --lan-peer on the same LAN.

decisions.notes: All nine queued Mac-to-Win items timed out against the recorded peer address because cross_reachable=false.

rationale: Windows is unreachable from Mac until both hosts run start.ps1 --lan-peer on the same LAN.
